name: Greased Floor (3-4)
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-05: Silver Bark, Golden Blades
description: The floor is highly waxed and slippery.
disable: DC 16 Survival check or DC 16 Thievery check to remove the slippery coating or any ability that turns the area into difficult terrain.

offensiveAbilities.name: Slip and Slide
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature walks into the greased area

Effect The triggering creature must make a successful DC 14 Acrobatics check to avoid falling Prone. The area is uneven ground.
